status: pilot protocol; freeze before first model run
task_suite: Silo-Bench upstream snapshot; 3 two-agent Level-I tasks
decoding: greedy; local Transformers; 320 token response cap
protocol: Silo-Bench P2P message tool; same engine and task files in all arms

conditions.unconstrained: No added message-format instruction; upstream system prompt only.
conditions.autoform_prompt: When sending a message, communicate the task-relevant information as concisely as possible. Prefer a clear structured format (for example a short list, key-value fields, JSON, or mathematical notation) when it helps. Preserve exact values needed by the recipient.
conditions.json_schema: When sending a message, the content must be exactly one valid JSON object with keys task, data, and note. Put the smallest task-relevant exact values in data; use an empty note unless a clarification is essential. Do not put prose outside the object.

intervention_control: no_communication: Silo send_message action disabled; no injected knowledge
limitations: One small open model and a tiny fixed task sample cannot support general superiority claims.
AutoForm is prompted but not an exact reimplementation of its paper's model-selected format workflow.
Only P2P topology is held fixed; protocol selection is not the question in this pilot.
The local model is single-process and sequential; its latency is not representative of a production multi-agent service.
